prompt_package.style_lock: Western medieval fantasy illustrated in expressive Japanese sumi-e on warm handmade washi. Black and charcoal-gray ink washes, feathered edges, irregular dry-brush contours, layered atmospheric distance and generous unpainted paper. Map, town, forge, event and UI feel drawn on the same page; compact readable annotation-like controls. Not a simple sepia filter on clean vector graphics.
